subject: Aurelia Analytics — procurement kickoff: DPA, subprocessors, PO next steps
messages:
From: Sarah Tierney <sarah.tierney@aurelia.ai>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@aurelia.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup: initial info for Redwood onboarding

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this — we're excited to move Redwood into our stack for inference. Procurement asked me to send a single-threaded kickoff so we can get the vendor setup and PO process started. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirmation whether Redwood requires a signed DPA (we usually do one if customer data leaves our environment)
- Current list of subprocessors (if you can provide a CSV or spreadsheet)
- Data retention defaults (logs, usage telemetry, and any model caching retention)
- A PO template and invoice remit details so procurement can draft the order

We can share our security questionnaire and sign a DPA; attaching the questionnaire if it helps. Also attaching a contact for billing (procurement@aurelia.ai).

Can you confirm the above and outline the next steps timeline? We're aiming to have a pilot PO and technical onboarding completed in the next 2–3 weeks.

Thanks,

Sarah Tierney
Procurement Lead
Aurelia Analytics
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Aurelia_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf, 820 KB)

From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Tierney <sarah.tierney@aurelia.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: initial info for Redwood onboarding

Hi Sarah — welcome, and thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (legal/procurement lead) and Jonas (technical onboarding). Quick answers and next steps below:

- DPA: Yes, Redwood requires a standard DPA for customers using customer data. We have a template we can share; redlines are acceptable but please indicate any non-negotiable clauses on your side.
- Subprocessors: We maintain a current subprocessors CSV and will attach the latest export. If you'd like a monthly cadence for updates, we can do that.
- Data retention: Default telemetry/log retention is 90 days; model KV cache is customer-configurable and can be pinned/evicted on request. For enterprise/private deployments retention windows can be customized in the contract.
- PO & billing: Our procurement team accepts PO to accounts-payable@redwood.ai. Standard net-30, but we can discuss terms for pilot/enterprise. I'll attach a PO draft for your review.

Action items we will take now:
1) Share Redwood DPA template and the current subprocessors CSV (attached).
2) Send a short procurement intake form to capture billing remit, tax id, and contact — will come from Jonas.
3) Marissa will kickoff any legal questions once you've had a chance to review the DPA.

Proposed timeline:
- Today/Tomorrow: send DPA + subprocessors + PO draft
- 1–3 business days: Aurelia to confirm PO terms & remit
- 5–10 business days: complete DPA review/signature

If that works, we'll start the intake and loop in our finance team as needed.

Best,

Olga Petrov
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 45 KB); Redwood_Subprocessors_2026-06.csv (text/csv, 12 KB); Redwood_PO_Template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 28 KB)

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Aurelia — quick legal/procurement clarifications

Olga / Jonas — a few clarifications from legal before we send the DPA + PO to the customer:

- Data classification: Do we have confirmation from Aurelia whether they'll send any regulated data (e.g., PHI, PCI)? Sarah's note implies customer PII only, but we should confirm in writing. If PHI is in scope we need our BA agreements and HCLS controls explicit.
- Subprocessor scope: If any subprocessors handle unredacted data, we should ask for a schema of what fields they will send. Requesting a CSV from the vendor is fine but let's also include a brief question: "Will any of the listed subprocessors process unredacted customer data?"
- Retention: Our default of 90 days is fine for telemetry, but ask whether Aurelia requires longer retention for audit logs. If they do, note that longer retention may change pricing.
- PO terms: propose we keep standard net-30 for pilot, but include an explicit clause: "Work to commence upon PO receipt and valid billing details; payment terms net-30 from invoice date."

Please hold DPA send until we get Sarah's confirmation on PHI/regulated data and the remit address. Once we have that we can push the DPA and PO draft.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Contracts & Procurement
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Hi Olga / team — thanks for the quick follow-up and apologies for the delay. Answers and artifacts attached:

- PHI/regulated data: Confirmed — Aurelia will not be sending PHI. We may send limited customer PII (email, user_id) as part of inference requests.
- Subprocessors: Attached CSV (Aurelia_Subprocessors_2026-06.csv) lists our integrations. None of the listed subprocessors will receive unredacted customer data; we've marked "data_scope" in the sheet.
- Retention ask: For the pilot we only need the default 90-day retention for logs. If we expand to enterprise we'll revisit retention windows and cost.
- PO & billing: Sending PO draft via DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/PO/AURE-7892. Billing remit: Aurelia Analytics, Attn Accounts Payable, 800 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94102; TAX ID: 94-1234567.

Attachments: Aurelia_Subprocessors_2026-06.csv (text/csv, 4 KB); Aurelia_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2 MB); Aurelia_PO_Draft_20260616.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 34 KB)

Let us know if the DPA draft needs edits; procurement@aurelia.ai will handle the PO signature. Looking forward to the pilot kickoff.

Best,
Sarah
